comparison-partial-sums.alt: Partial sums S sub N for N = 1 to 12 of two series, plotted as dots. The upper dots, for the series of 1 over n squared, rise from 1 and level off just under a dashed line at pi squared over 6, about 1.645. The lower dots, for the series of 1 over (n squared + 1), rise from 0.5 and level off near 1.08, always below the upper dots. Smaller positive terms give smaller partial sums, trapped under the same ceiling.
